rehearsal.ranFrom: a clean checkout of the release commit, with --ci-run naming the producer CI run

inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.12.1: the same 86 files by count. dist/index.js, its map, dist/drawings.js and both declaration entries change for the drawing toolbar's collapse pill and UiConfig.drawingToolbarToggle; the stylesheet gains the pill and the tucked-away toolbar; the 20 language chunks, the shared chunk and the assets declaration chunk take new hashed names for the two added catalog keys; package.json and the feature manifest change the version and gain the new key; README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the pill. The export map, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, theme manifest and REST description are unchanged.

ownerWaiver.statement: Yeah add the collapse but we dont need to deploy it yet but add it as a release to qc and local app should get it at main
ownerWaiver.question: Quick Charts 5.13.0, the drawing toolbar's collapse pill, needs the owner's approval of publishing and the owner's waiver of manual accessibility and per-browser acceptance before it is tagged, released and adopted by the app.
ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Given in chat as the instruction to add the collapse as a Quick Charts release and bring it to the app's main without a deploy; the release records it word for word. Manual accessibility and advertised browser and device acceptance were not performed; the browser suites passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
